body:
![a blog post cover about 5 best canva alternatives for fillable forms](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/How_to_Make_User_Research_Survey_7b9d34b8f7.png) Canva is a fantastic tool for designing visuals, but it falls short when it comes to building interactive, fillable forms. While **[Canva form builder](https://www.canva.com/create/forms/)** allows users to create beautiful PDFs and static form templates, it lacks key features like data collection, automation, conditional logic, and payment integrations. If you're looking for a **[Canva alternative for form building](/plugins/canva-form-builder/)**, you need a tool that not only looks great but also functions effectively. In this post, we’ll explore five of the **best Canva form builder alternatives** that offer easy-to-use, visually appealing, and highly functional form-building capabilities. ## What Makes a Great Canva Alternative for Forms? Before diving into the alternatives, let’s break down the essential features a good form builder should have: - **Easy Drag-and-Drop Design** – Like Canva, a great form builder should allow you to create beautiful forms without any coding. - **Data Collection & Automation** – Forms should store responses, integrate with Google Sheets, and automate tasks like sending emails. - **Custom Branding** – You should be able to personalize colors, logos, and themes to match your brand. - **Interactive Features** – Unlike Canva, a form tool should support conditional logic, file uploads, e-signatures, and payments. - **Share & Embed Options** – Forms should work well on websites, social media, and mobile devices. Now, let’s check out the best tools that offer all these features and more! ## The 5 Best Canva Alternatives for Form Building in 2025 Below is the curated list of top tools that are better than Canva Form Builder: ### 1. Formester – Best for AI-Powered, Fillable Forms ![a mockup of formester](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/formester_b9e7754abe.png) **[Formester](/)** is an excellent Canva alternative because it offers the perfect mix of design, automation, and AI-powered form creation. Unlike Canva, where form-building is manual, Formester's **[AI form generator](/ai-form-generator/)** can generate entire forms, quizzes, and surveys from a simple prompt. **Key Features:** - Drag-and-drop form builder with easy customization - Conditional logic to show/hide fields based on user responses - AI-powered form generation to create forms instantly - **[Integration](/integrations/)** with Google Sheets, Zapier, and payment gateways - Supports **[pre-filled fields](/features/pre-fill-fields/)**, e-signatures, and multi-page forms **Who is it for?** Marketers, business owners, educators, and agencies looking for a form builder with automation, analytics, and branding options. **Pricing:** Starts with a **free plan** and premium options start at **$12 per month**. >**[Try Formester for free-->](https://app.formester.com/users/sign_up)** ### 2. Jotform – Best for Advanced Customization ![a mockup of jotform](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/jotform_0ac615425e.png) Jotform is another strong alternative to Canva for creating interactive, data-driven forms. It provides thousands of templates, advanced integrations, and automation features. **Key Features:** - Massive library of form templates - HIPAA-compliant forms for healthcare and legal industries - Integration with over 1000+ tools like Google Drive, PayPal, and CRMs - Payment collection and approval workflows **Who is it for?** Businesses that need highly customizable forms with automation and advanced security. **Pricing:** **Free plan** available, but paid plans start at **$34 per month**. >Read more about the **[best Jotform alternatives](/blog/top-10-jotform-alternatives-or-sme-and-budget-friendly/)** ### 3. Typeform – Best for Conversational Forms ![a mockup of typeform](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/typeform_911b500df0.png) Typeform is perfect if you want forms that feel like real conversations rather than just static questionnaires. Unlike Canva, Typeform presents one question at a time, making forms more engaging. **Key Features:** - One-question-at-a-time layout for better user experience - Custom branding and design flexibility - Works well for surveys, quizzes, and feedback collection - Integrates with Slack, Google Sheets, and Mailchimp **Who is it for?** Businesses and marketers who want highly engaging, conversational forms for surveys, quizzes, and lead generation. **Pricing:** Free plan available; paid plans start at **$25 per month**. ### 4. Paperform – Best for Payment & Order Forms ![a mockup of paperform](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/paperform_408f91f490.png) Paperform is a great alternative if you're looking for a tool that combines form-building with rich text editing and media embedding. It's like a mix of Canva and a form builder! **Key Features:** - Visually rich, customizable form layouts - Accepts payments directly through Stripe and PayPal - Embeds videos, images, and custom branding elements - Smart form logic and automation options **Who is it for?** Small businesses, freelancers, and e-commerce sellers who need forms with payment collection. **Pricing:** Paid plans start at **$24 per month**. ### 5. Google Forms – Best Free Alternative ![a mockup of google forms](https://formester-strapi.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/google_forms_5719259c33.png) If you’re on a budget and need a simple, no-frills alternative to Canva, Google Forms is a solid choice. While it doesn’t offer advanced branding or AI-powered features, it’s completely free and integrates well with Google Sheets. **Key Features:** - 100% free with unlimited responses - Integrates with Google Sheets for easy data collection - Supports quizzes, surveys, and feedback forms - No design customization, but great for quick form creation **Who is it for?** Educators, students, and small teams who need a free, easy-to-use form builder. **Pricing:** Completely free for all users. >Read more about the **[best Google Forms alternatives](/blog/top-google-forms-alternatives/)** ### Which Canva Alternative is Right for You? Choosing the best Canva alternative for form building depends on what you need:
Need Best Option
AI-powered, interactive forms Formester
Highly customizable, advanced forms Jotform
Engaging, conversational forms Typeform
Payment & e-commerce forms Paperform
Free, basic form builder Google Forms
If you're looking for a balance of ease, automation, and design, Formester is the best alternative to Canva. It combines AI-powered form creation, customization, and integrations, making it a complete solution for businesses, marketers, and educators. ### Conclusion **Canva is great** for creating static designs, but when it comes to building fillable, data-driven forms, you need a better tool. The five alternatives listed above offer the best interactive, customizable, and **automated form-building** experiences. If you want a tool that can generate entire forms with AI, collect payments, and integrate seamlessly with other platforms, **Formester is your best bet.**
